import collections, json
def f(g, anom_color):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    best=None
    for ph in range(1,H+1):
        for pw in range(1,W+1):
            slots={}; nconflict=0
            ok=True
            for r in range(H):
                for c in range(W):
                    i,j=r%ph,c%pw; v=g[r][c]
                    if v==anom_color: 
                        continue
                    d=slots.setdefault((i,j),set())
                    if v in d: continue
                    d.add(v); nconflict+=1
                    if len(d)>1: ok=False
            if not ok: continue
            # build pattern: slot value = any seen value
            pat=[[list(slots.get((i,j),[])) for j in range(pw)] for i in range(ph)]
            out=[[pat[r%ph][c%pw] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
            # count anom cells (wildcard fills)
            na=sum(1 for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==anom_color)
            cost=(na, ph*pw)
            if (best is None or cost<best[0]):
                best=(cost,na,ph,pw,out)
    return best
b=f(G['Demo pair 1 input'],6)
print('demo:', b[:3], 'match:', b[4]==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
o=f(G['Test input'],1)
print('test na:', o[1], 'tile:', o[2:], 'match none')
for row in o[4]: print(' '.join(map(str,row)))
open('/tmp/sub.json','w').write(json.dumps(o[4]))
